families.name: New1_Codex_MossRoofCottage
families.note: Eight-by-six tile hollow cottage: flat ochre parapet roof, masonry piers, arched boarded door, inset dark panes, planters and roof moss. Rear/inside inferred; crow excluded.

families.name: New1_Codex_OliveConeTree

families.name: New1_Codex_TallGrassPatch

families.name: New1_Codex_Woodpile

families.name: New1_Codex_ChoppingStumpAxe

families.name: New1_Codex_PlanterPlant
